paragraphs: International gold is at $4,140 an ounce, the rupee at ₹95.18 to the dollar, and the Indian jeweller board median at ₹14,809/g for 24K.
What the world's gold news is about today: US interest rates (10 headlines), The US dollar (3 headlines), Inflation (3 headlines), Investment flows (ETFs) (2 headlines).

US interest rates. Gold pays no interest, so expectations of lower US rates tend to support it and higher rates tend to weigh on it. In the news: Gold Prices Rise Above $4,200 in Futures Trading as Fed Rate Hike Expectations Ease (Yahoo Finance); Gold edges lower as firm dollar, elevated yields weigh (Reuters).

The US dollar. Gold is priced in dollars: a stronger dollar usually pushes it down, a weaker one lifts it. In the news: Gold edges lower as firm dollar, elevated yields weigh (Reuters); Gold retests $4,200 as dollar and yields retreat — can bullion clear its hardest level? (Mitrade).

Inflation. Gold is held as an inflation hedge, though hot inflation can also mean higher rates, which cuts the other way. In the news: Precious Metals StoneX Bullion weekly round-up 101926; US Inflation higher-for-longer? (StoneX); Gold Prices Fall Below $4,100, US Inflation Boosts Rate Hike Bets (VOI.ID).
